subject: DI02005021

body.en:
Definition

Screening partitions particles by ability to pass an aperture; actual separation is probabilistic and affected by shape, orientation and contact.

Classification

  • Ideal screen sends all smaller particles to undersize and all larger to oversize. Actual streams contain misplaced particles.
  • Differential analysis reports the fraction retained in each interval; cumulative retained/passing sums fractions above/below a size.

Explanation

  • Arrange sieves largest opening at top, pan below; divide each retained dry mass by total recovered mass and check closure.
  • Label cumulative passing versus retained; they are complementary only on the same complete mass basis. Do not use a zero pan diameter in mean-size calculations.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Apertureમાંથી પસાર થવાની ક્ષમતા પરથી screening થાય; actual separation shape, orientation/contactને કારણે સંપૂર્ણ ચોક્કસ નથી.

વર્ગીકરણ

  • Ideal screenમાં બધા નાના undersize અને મોટા oversizeમાં જાય; actual streamsમાં misplaced particles હોય.
  • Differential analysis દરેક intervalનો retained fraction આપે; cumulative retained/passing size ઉપર/નીચેના fractionsનો સરવાળો છે.

સમજણ

  • સૌથી મોટી openingની sieve ઉપર, pan નીચે; retained dry mass/કુલ recovered mass લો અને closure તપાસો.
  • Cumulative passing/retained સ્પષ્ટ લખો; સમાન complete mass basisમાં જ complementary. Pan માટે zero diameter ન લો.

body.en:
Definition

Capacity is feed mass handled per time, or per screen area when stated. Effectiveness quantifies correct placement of both coarse and fine material.

Exam-ready ordered derivation

  1. Take a steady dry-mass basis.Let F, O, U be feed, oversize and undersize rates; all x values are fractions COARSER than the selected cut.
  2. Overall balance:F=O+U.Coarse balance:FxF=OxO+UxU.Each term has mass/time units.
  3. Substitute U=F−O:FxF=OxO+(F−O)xU=O(xO−xU)+FxU.
  4. Rearrange:O/F=(xF−xU)/(xO−xU).Subtract from1 to obtain U/F=(xO−xF)/(xO−xU).
  5. Correct coarse recovery rC=OxO/(FxF).Correct fine recovery rF=U(1−xU)/[F(1−xF)], because1−x denotes the fine fraction.
  6. Define overall effectiveness as E=rC rF.Substitution gives E=[xO(1−xU)/(xF(1−xF))]×[(xF−xU)(xO−xF)/(xO−xU)²].
  7. Use fractions in the formula; percent effectiveness=100E.Ideal separation gives xO=1, xU=0 and E=1, which checks the expression.
  8. Capacity per area is F/Ascreen, with declared units.It is a throughput measure, not the above effectiveness.Require representative analyses and nonzero denominators.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Capacity feed mass/time, અથવા જણાવ્યા મુજબ screen area દીઠ છે. Effectiveness coarse/fine બંનેનું યોગ્ય placement માપે.

પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ક્રમબદ્ધ તારવણી

  1. Steady dry-mass basisમાં F, O, U feed/oversize/undersize rates; બધા x selected cutથી COARSER fractions છે.
  2. Overall balance F=O+U; coarse balance FxF=OxO+UxU.દર term mass/timeમાં છે.
  3. U=F−O substitute:FxF=OxO+(F−O)xU=O(xO−xU)+FxU.
  4. Rearrange:O/F=(xF−xU)/(xO−xU); 1માંથી બાદ કરતાં U/F=(xO−xF)/(xO−xU).
  5. Correct coarse recovery rC=OxO/(FxF); fine recovery rF=U(1−xU)/[F(1−xF)], કારણ1−x fine fraction છે.
  6. Overall effectiveness E=rC rF.Substitute કરતાં E=[xO(1−xU)/(xF(1−xF))]×[(xF−xU)(xO−xF)/(xO−xU)²].
  7. Formulaમાં fractions લો; percent effectiveness=100E.Ideal xO=1, xU=0માં E=1 મળે છે એટલે check થાય.
  8. Area capacity F/Ascreen declared units સાથે throughput બતાવે, effectiveness નહીં.Representative analyses તથા nonzero denominators જરૂરી.

body.en:
Definition

An inclined rotating perforated drum that separates solids by aperture passage.

Principle

  • Tumbling renews particle contact with openings while gravity advances the bed.

Construction—detailed theory

The separating surface is a cylindrical perforated drum (1), mounted with a slight inclination on rollers and a supporting frame (2). A guarded drive (3) rotates the drum. Feed enters the raised end (4), while the lower end provides an outlet for oversize (6). A collection hopper or chute below the drum receives undersize (5).

Aperture shape, drum length and diameter are selected for the duty. Rotation exposes fresh portions of the bed to the perforations, while inclination promotes axial transport. The shell needs sufficient open area and structural support; its perforations perform the sizing, whereas the supports and drive provide motion rather than an additional separation mechanism.

Working—detailed theory

Feed enters the raised end and is lifted part-way by the rotating shell. It then tumbles and rolls back across the perforated surface, repeatedly presenting particles to the openings. Particles that are small enough and correctly oriented pass through the holes and fall into the undersize collector. Repeated presentation improves the chance of passage compared with a single contact.

The remaining material travels towards the lower end under the combined influence of tumbling and inclination. Coarse particles unable to pass through the openings leave there as oversize. Feed rate, inclination, rotational speed, moisture and aperture blinding affect residence time and separation. Excessive speed can reduce useful tumbling; a trommel is not intended to act as a centrifuge.

Applications

  • Coarse mineral/aggregate screening where robust tumbling is useful.

Limitations and safety

  • Blinding, wear and large space; moving drum must remain guarded.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Inclined ફરતા perforated drumથી aperture મુજબ વિભાજન થાય.

સિદ્ધાંત

  • Tumblingથી openings સાથે contact વધે, gravityથી bed આગળ જાય.

રચના—વિગતવાર સમજણ

Separating surface cylindrical perforated drum (1) છે, જે rollers/frame (2) પર થોડા inclination સાથે ગોઠવાય છે. Guarded drive (3) drumને ફેરવે છે. Feed raised end (4)થી આવે; lower end oversize outlet (6) છે. નીચેનો hopper/chute undersize (5) ભેગો કરે છે.

Duty મુજબ aperture shape, drum length/diameter પસંદ થાય છે. Rotationથી bedના નવા ભાગો perforations પાસે આવે અને inclinationથી axial transport મળે. Shellમાં પૂરતું open area/structural support હોય છે. Sizing perforations કરે છે; supports/drive motion આપે, અલગ separation mechanism નહીં.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ—વિગતવાર સમજણ

Feed raised endમાં આવી rotating shell સાથે થોડું ઊંચકાય છે. પછી તે tumble/roll થઈ perforated surface પર પાછું આવે એટલે particles વારંવાર openings પાસે આવે છે. પૂરતા નાના તથા યોગ્ય orientationવાળા particles holesમાંથી undersize collectorમાં પડે છે. વારંવાર presentationથી એક contact કરતાં passageની તક વધે છે.

બાકી material tumbling/inclinationથી lower end તરફ જાય છે. Openingsમાંથી ન પસાર થનારા coarse particles oversize બને છે. Feed rate, inclination, speed, moisture/blindingથી residence time/separation બદલાય છે. ખૂબ speedથી useful tumbling ઘટે; તેનાથી centrifuge જેવી કામગીરી કરાવવી નથી.

ઉપયોગો

  • Coarse mineral/aggregate screeningમાં robust tumbling ઉપયોગી.

મર્યાદા તથા સલામતી

  • Blinding, wear તથા વધુ જગ્યા; drum guarded રહે.

body.en:
Definition

A coarse screen made of parallel bars, usually inclined.

Principle

  • Smaller pieces fall through bar spaces while large lumps slide over.

Construction—detailed theory

A grizzly consists of strong parallel bars (1) secured in a rigid support frame (2). Clear spaces between the bars form the screening openings (3). The bar surface is commonly inclined to provide a feed path (4), with a fines hopper below (5) and a coarse discharge beyond the lower end (6).

The bars withstand coarse, heavy feed and may be arranged to reduce wedging. Spacing is chosen for a coarse scalping duty rather than fine precision analysis. The illustrated arrangement is a stationary grizzly: it has no rotating drum or driven mesh. Vibrating grizzlies exist, but their additional drive must not be assumed in the stationary sketch.

Working—detailed theory

Feed is delivered to the upper portion and spreads across the bars. Gravity, feed momentum and the slope move the bed towards the discharge. Finer particles reaching a clear space fall through under gravity, while larger pieces bridge across neighbouring bars. Separation therefore depends mainly on whether a particle can pass through the bar spacing.

Fines are collected underneath, and coarse pieces continue to the lower end for separate handling, often before crushing. Feed depth, particle shape and wet sticky material can reduce efficiency by preventing fines from reaching the openings. Long thin pieces may pass differently from equant particles, so bar spacing is not an exact spherical product diameter.

Applications

  • Scalping coarse feed before primary crushing.

Limitations and safety

  • Not precision fine sizing; bars can bridge or clog. Never clear with the feed system live.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

સામાન્ય રીતે inclined parallel barsથી બનેલી coarse screen.

સિદ્ધાંત

  • નાના ટુકડા bar gapsમાંથી પડે; મોટા lumps ઉપર સરકે.

રચના—વિગતવાર સમજણ

Grizzlyમાં મજબૂત parallel bars (1) rigid frame (2)માં ગોઠવાય છે. Bars વચ્ચેની clear spaces screening openings (3) બને છે. Bar surface સામાન્ય રીતે inclined feed path (4) બનાવે; નીચે fines hopper (5) અને lower endની આગળ coarse discharge (6) હોય છે.

Bars coarse/heavy feed સહન કરે અને wedging ઘટાડવા suitable arrangement હોઈ શકે. Spacing coarse scalping માટે હોય, fine precision analysis માટે નહીં. દર્શાવેલું stationary grizzly છે; તેમાં rotating drum/driven mesh નથી. Vibrating grizzly પણ હોય, પરંતુ તેની drive stationary sketchમાં માની લેવી નહીં.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ—વિગતવાર સમજણ

Feed upper portion પર આવી bars ઉપર ફેલાય છે. Gravity, feed momentum/slopeથી bed discharge તરફ જાય છે. Clear space સુધી પહોંચેલા fines gravityથી નીચે પડે; મોટા pieces પડોશી bars વચ્ચે bridge થાય. તેથી separation મુખ્યત્વે bar spacingમાંથી પસાર થઈ શકવાની ક્ષમતા પર આધારિત છે.

Fines નીચે collect થાય; coarse pieces lower endથી અલગ handlingમાં, ઘણીવાર crushing પહેલાં, જાય છે. Feed depth, shape તથા wet/sticky material finesને openings સુધી પહોંચતા રોકીને efficiency ઘટાડે છે. લાંબા પાતળા piecesનું passage જુદું હોય; bar spacing ચોક્કસ spherical product diameter નથી.

ઉપયોગો

  • Primary crushing પહેલાં coarse feedનું scalping.

મર્યાદા તથા સલામતી

  • Precision fine sizing નહીં; bridging/clogging થાય. Live systemમાં clearing નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

A screen deck driven in oscillatory motion to increase particle presentation to apertures.

Principle

  • Vibration stratifies and advances the bed; undersize passes through the deck.

Construction—detailed theory

A replaceable mesh or perforated deck (1) is mounted on a frame supported by springs (3). An eccentric or vibratory drive (2) produces controlled oscillation of the deck. A feed distributor (4) supplies material across the width. Separate chutes collect undersize below (5) and oversize at the deck end (6).

Deck angle, aperture, tension, vibration frequency and amplitude are selected together. The springs permit the required motion while limiting its transmission to the foundation. The deck may be inclined or arranged for transport by its motion; the sketch shows a single screening surface, not a compulsory multi-deck machine. Guards protect the moving drive.

Working—detailed theory

Controlled feed lands on the vibrating deck. Oscillation loosens the bed and encourages stratification: smaller particles can move down through spaces between larger particles towards the mesh. Repeated lifting and landing renew contact with the openings, helping suitably small particles pass through instead of remaining trapped in the upper bed.

Undersize falls into the lower chute, whereas oversize travels along the deck and exits at the end. Vibration and inclination control transport and residence time, but do not guarantee ideal separation. Excess feed depth, damaged mesh or blinded apertures may carry fines into oversize or allow oversize leakage; effectiveness must therefore be measured from stream analyses.

Applications

  • Mineral sizing, product grading and closed-circuit classification.

Limitations and safety

  • Moisture, near-size feed, blinding and excess loading reduce effectiveness. Guarded drives/isolation required.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Oscillatory motionવાળી screen deckથી particles openings પાસે વારંવાર આવે.

સિદ્ધાંત

  • Vibrationથી bed stratify/આગળ વધે; undersize deckમાંથી પસાર થાય.

રચના—વિગતવાર સમજણ

Replaceable mesh/perforated deck (1) spring-supported frame (3) પર હોય છે. Eccentric/vibratory drive (2) deckને controlled oscillation આપે. Feed distributor (4) materialને widthમાં ફેલાવે. નીચેની chute undersize (5) તથા deck endની chute oversize (6) ભેગાં કરે છે.

Deck angle, aperture, tension, vibration frequency/amplitude સાથે પસંદ થાય છે. Springs required motion આપે તથા foundationમાં vibration transmission ઘટાડે છે. Deck inclined હોય કે motionથી transport કરાવે; આકૃતિ single surface બતાવે છે, compulsory multi-deck નહીં. Moving drive guarded હોય છે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ—વિગતવાર સમજણ

Controlled feed vibrating deck પર આવે છે. Oscillationથી bed ઢીલો પડે અને stratification મળે; નાના particles મોટાઓ વચ્ચેની spacesમાંથી mesh તરફ ઊતરી શકે. વારંવાર lift/landingથી openings સાથે નવા contacts મળે એટલે યોગ્ય નાના particles upper bedમાં અટકવાને બદલે પસાર થાય છે.

Undersize નીચેની chuteમાં પડે અને oversize deck પર આગળ જઈ endથી બહાર જાય. Vibration/inclination transport તથા residence time નક્કી કરે, ideal separationની ખાતરી નહીં. વધુ feed depth, damaged mesh/blindingથી fines oversizeમાં જાય કે oversize leak થાય; તેથી stream analysesથી effectiveness માપવી પડે.

ઉપયોગો

  • Mineral sizing, product grading તથા closed-circuit classification.

મર્યાદા તથા સલામતી

  • Moisture, near-size feed, blinding/overloadingથી effectiveness ઘટે. Guards/isolation જરૂરી.

body.en:
Definition

A wet gravity separator using pulsating water through a supported particle bed.

Principle

  • Repeated expansion/settling stratifies suitable particles, mainly by density with size/shape effects.

Construction—detailed theory

A hydraulic jig has a tank containing a supported screen and particle bed (1). A water-filled hutch lies below the screen (2), connected to a piston, diaphragm or equivalent pulsation chamber (3). Feed is supplied above the bed (4). Separate arrangements withdraw the lighter upper product (5) and the denser bed product (6).

The screen retains the intended bed while allowing the pulsating water to pass. Some designs use a ragging layer or collect fine heavy particles through the bed; these are design-dependent features. The illustrated dense outlet represents controlled withdrawal from the lower bed, not a claim that every heavy particle must pass through the screen.

Working—detailed theory

The pulsator sends an upward water pulse through the screen, expanding and loosening the bed. Particles then have space to rearrange instead of remaining locked together. During the changing flow and settling part of the cycle, particles with different settling responses move differently; for suitable size ranges the denser particles tend towards lower positions and lighter particles towards upper positions.

Repeated pulsation develops a stratified bed. The light upper layer is carried to its overflow, while controlled lower-bed withdrawal removes the dense product. Density is important, but size, shape, pulse conditions and bed depth also influence separation; a jig is not a perfect density sorter for an unrestricted size mixture. Feed preparation and withdrawal rates help maintain the layers.

Applications

  • Density separation of suitably sized mineral/coal feeds.

Limitations and safety

  • Size and density effects interact; not a perfect density-only split. No access to moving pulsators.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Supported particle bedમાંથી pulsating waterથી wet gravity separation કરતું સાધન.

સિદ્ધાંત

  • Repeated expansion/settlingથી stratification; મુખ્યત્વે density, સાથે size/shapeની અસર.

રચના—વિગતવાર સમજણ

Hydraulic jigના tankમાં supported screen/particle bed (1) હોય છે. Screen નીચે water-filled hutch (2) piston/diaphragm જેવી pulsation chamber (3) સાથે જોડાય છે. Feed bed ઉપર (4) આવે. Light upper product (5) તથા dense bed product (6) માટે અલગ withdrawal arrangements હોય છે.

Screen intended bed રોકે પરંતુ pulsating water પસાર કરે. અમુક designમાં ragging layer હોય કે fine heavies bedમાંથી collect થાય; તે design-dependent છે. દર્શાવેલો dense outlet lower bedમાંથી controlled withdrawal બતાવે છે; દરેક heavy particle screenમાંથી જ પસાર થાય એવું નથી.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ—વિગતવાર સમજણ

Pulsatorથી water pulse screenમાંથી ઉપર જઈ bedને expand/loosen કરે છે. તેથી particles એકબીજા સાથે locked રહેવાને બદલે ફરી ગોઠવાય શકે. Flow બદલાવ તથા settling phaseમાં જુદા settling responsesથી relative movement થાય; યોગ્ય size rangesમાં denser particles નીચે અને lighter ઉપર ગોઠવાવાની વૃત્તિ ધરાવે છે.

Repeated pulsationથી stratified bed બને છે. Light upper layer overflow તરફ જાય અને controlled lower withdrawalથી dense product મળે. Density ઉપરાંત size, shape, pulse conditions/bed depth પણ અસર કરે; unrestricted size mixtureનું perfect density sorting થતું નથી. Feed preparation/withdrawal ratesથી layers જાળવાય છે.

ઉપયોગો

  • યોગ્ય sizeના mineral/coalમાં density separation.

મર્યાદા તથા સલામતી

  • Size/density બંને અસર કરે; perfect density-only split નહીં. Moving pulsator પાસે પ્રવેશ નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

A hydraulic classifier with an adjustable inner cone inside an outer cone, not a double-cone blender.

Principle

  • Particles compete between settling and upward hydraulic-water motion in the annular region.[1]

Construction—detailed theory

The classifier has a stationary outer cone with a coarse-solids outlet at its bottom (1). An adjustable truncated inner cone, with its apex directed downward, is fitted inside it (2). Slurry feed enters the inner cone through a central connection (3). A lower baffle (4) helps redirect the feed emerging from the inner opening.

Hydraulic water is admitted near the base (5), and the top launder collects overflow (6). The space between the two cones forms an upward classification passage. Adjusting the inner cone changes the effective flow geometry. This is a hydraulic classifier with stationary cone surfaces, not a rotating double-cone blender used for mixing dry powders.

Working—detailed theory

Slurry flows down through the inner cone and emerges near its lower opening, where the baffle spreads it into the surrounding classification region. Water introduced near the base rises through the annular passage. The particles therefore meet an upward liquid flow rather than simply dropping through two empty cones.

Particles whose settling tendency exceeds the local upward transport move down against the flow and leave as coarse underflow. Particles carried upward with the liquid reach the top launder as fine overflow. Water rate, slurry loading, cone position and settling properties influence the cut. Separation reflects settling velocity, so density and shape can affect the result as well as size.

Applications

  • Wet classification/washing of suitable granular mineral suspensions.

Limitations and safety

  • Feed concentration, water flow and size/density govern the cut; no universal sharp separation.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Outer coneની અંદર adjustable inner coneવાળો hydraulic classifier; double-cone blender નહીં.

સિદ્ધાંત

  • Annular regionમાં settling તથા upward hydraulic-water motionથી separation.[1]

રચના—વિગતવાર સમજણ

Classifierમાં stationary outer cone તથા bottom coarse outlet (1) હોય છે. અંદર apex નીચે રાખેલો adjustable truncated inner cone (2) ગોઠવાય છે. Central connection (3)થી slurry inner coneમાં આવે છે. Lower baffle (4) inner openingમાંથી આવતો feed redirect કરવામાં મદદ કરે છે.

Base પાસે hydraulic water inlet (5) અને ઉપર overflow launder (6) હોય છે. બે cones વચ્ચે upward classification passage બને છે. Inner cone adjustmentથી effective flow geometry બદલાય છે. આ stationary conesવાળું hydraulic classifier છે; dry powder મિશ્રણ માટે rotating double-cone blender નથી.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ—વિગતવાર સમજણ

Slurry inner coneમાંથી નીચે જઈ lower opening પાસે બહાર આવે; બાફલ તેને આસપાસના classification regionમાં ફેલાવે છે. Baseથી આવતું water annular passageમાં ઉપર ચડે છે. તેથી particles upward liquid flowને મળે છે; માત્ર બે ખાલી conesમાંથી નીચે પડતા નથી.

જે particlesની settling tendency local upward transport કરતાં વધુ હોય તે flow સામે નીચે જઈ coarse underflow બને. Liquid સાથે ઉપર વહેતા particles top launderમાં fine overflow બને. Water rate, slurry loading, cone position/settling properties cutને અસર કરે. Settling velocity આધાર હોવાથી size ઉપરાંત density/shape પણ અસર કરે છે.

ઉપયોગો

  • Granular mineral suspensionનું wet classification/washing.

મર્યાદા તથા સલામતી

  • Feed concentration, water flow તથા size/densityથી cut બદલાય; universal sharp split નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

An electrical collector that removes suspended particles from a gas. Although listed in Unit3, it is physically gas–solid separation.

Principle

  • Ionisation charges particles; an electric field drives them to collecting surfaces.

Construction—detailed theory

The enclosed gas passage includes an inlet distributor (1), slender discharge electrodes (2) and larger collecting plates or surfaces (3). An insulated, enclosed high-voltage supply (4) creates the required electric field between these elements. The electrodes and collectors have different functions; they should not be described as ordinary sieve bars.

A rapping or other designed cleaning arrangement dislodges deposits into a dust hopper (5), while the cleaned-gas outlet lies downstream (6). Flow distribution limits bypassing and excessive local velocity. The drawing omits detailed insulators, interlocks and controls; actual high-voltage equipment requires engineered isolation and trained maintenance, not student energisation.

Working—detailed theory

Dust-laden gas passes through the electrode region. A corona near the discharge electrodes ionises the gas, and charge is transferred to suspended particles. The electric field then causes charged particles to migrate towards collecting surfaces, while most of the carrier gas continues along the passage. Thus the separating force is electrical, not filtration through cloth.

Particles deposit on the collectors and are periodically removed by the designed cleaning system. The released dust falls into the hopper for enclosed discharge; cleaner gas leaves downstream. Collection depends on charging, migration, gas residence, particle properties and re-entrainment. Very poor flow distribution or excessive rapping can reduce performance even when the power supply operates.

Applications

  • Industrial flue-gas/dust control for suitable particle electrical properties.

Limitations and safety

  • Resistivity, gas distribution and re-entrainment affect performance. High voltage:theory only, no student energisation.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Gasમાંથી suspended particles કાઢતું electrical collector. Unit3માં listed હોવા છતાં વાસ્તવમાં gas–solid separation છે.

સિદ્ધાંત

  • Ionisationથી particles charged થાય; electric field તેમને collecting surfaces તરફ ખેંચે.

રચના—વિગતવાર સમજણ

Enclosed gas passageમાં inlet distributor (1), પાતળાં discharge electrodes (2) તથા મોટી collecting plates/surfaces (3) હોય છે. Insulated enclosed high-voltage supply (4) electric field બનાવે છે. Discharge electrode/collectorનાં functions જુદાં છે; તેમને ordinary sieve bars ન માનવા.

Rapping/બીજી designed cleaning arrangement depositsને dust hopper (5)માં પાડે છે; downstream cleaned-gas outlet (6) હોય છે. Flow distribution bypass/excess local velocity ઘટાડે છે. Drawingમાં detailed insulators/interlocks/controls સરળ કરેલ છે; actual high-voltage system માટે engineered isolation/trained maintenance જોઈએ, student energisation નહીં.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ—વિગતવાર સમજણ

Dust-laden gas electrode regionમાં આવે છે. Discharge electrodes પાસે coronaથી gas ionise થાય અને suspended particlesને charge મળે છે. Electric fieldથી charged particles collecting surfaces તરફ migrate થાય, જ્યારે carrier gas passageમાં આગળ જાય છે. તેથી force electrical છે; cloth filtration નથી.

Particles collectors પર જમા થાય અને designed cleaningથી સમયાંતરે દૂર થાય છે. છૂટેલો dust hopperમાં પડી enclosed dischargeમાં જાય; cleaner gas આગળથી નીકળે છે. Charging, migration, residence, particle properties/re-entrainmentથી collection બદલાય. Poor flow distribution કે excessive rappingથી power supply ચાલુ હોવા છતાં performance ઘટી શકે છે.

ઉપયોગો

  • યોગ્ય electrical propertiesવાળી industrial flue-gas/dust control.

મર્યાદા તથા સલામતી

  • Resistivity, gas distribution/re-entrainment અસર કરે. High voltage:માત્ર theory, student energisation નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

A separator using differences in magnetic response; the diagram shows a magnetic drum.

Principle

  • Magnetic force retains responsive particles while gravity/inertia release less-responsive material.

Construction—detailed theory

The illustrated separator uses a nonmagnetic rotating drum shell fed by a controlled distributor (1). A fixed magnetic sector is located inside the shell (2), while a guarded drive rotates the shell around it (3). The magnet does not need to rotate with the outer drum in this arrangement.

A splitter and separate bins (6) collect the nonmagnetic stream leaving its natural trajectory (4) and the magnetic stream released beyond the effective field (5). The magnet arc, feed thickness and collection geometry are selected for the material. Separation requires a useful difference in magnetic response; it is not suitable merely because two solids have different colours or densities.

Working—detailed theory

A thin controlled layer reaches the rotating shell within the magnetic field. Magnetically responsive particles are attracted and retained against the shell. Nonmagnetic particles are not held by the field and depart under gravity and their momentum, entering the nonmagnetic collector. The splitter helps prevent the two trajectories from being recombined.

The shell carries retained magnetic particles around the field sector. When they move beyond sufficiently strong attraction, they detach into the magnetic collector. Field strength, particle liberation, layer depth and drum speed affect recovery and purity. A high magnetic-product mass alone does not prove good separation: desired-component recovery and product grade must be distinguished.

Applications

  • Removal/recovery of magnetic minerals or tramp iron in compatible feeds.

Limitations and safety

  • Liberation, size, moisture and field strength matter. Strong magnets threaten implants; guards remain closed.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Magnetic responseના તફાવતથી separation; આકૃતિ magnetic drumની છે.

સિદ્ધાંત

  • Magnetic force responsive particles પકડી રાખે; gravity/inertiaથી અન્ય material જુદું પડે.

રચના—વિગતવાર સમજણ

આ separatorમાં controlled distributor (1)થી nonmagnetic rotating drum shell પર feed આવે છે. Shellની અંદર fixed magnetic sector (2) હોય છે; guarded drive (3) outer shellને ફેરવે છે. આ arrangementમાં magnet outer drum સાથે ફરવો જરૂરી નથી.

Splitter/separate bins (6) natural trajectory (4)થી છૂટતો nonmagnetic stream અને effective fieldની આગળ release થતો magnetic stream (5) ભેગાં કરે. Magnet arc, feed thickness/collection geometry material પ્રમાણે હોય છે. Magnetic responseમાં ઉપયોગી તફાવત જરૂરી છે; માત્ર colour/density અલગ હોવાથી separation નહીં થાય.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ—વિગતવાર સમજણ

પાતળી controlled feed layer magnetic fieldવાળા rotating shell પર આવે છે. Responsive particles attract થઈ shell પાસે રહે છે. Nonmagnetic particles fieldથી ન પકડાતા gravity/momentumથી છૂટીને nonmagnetic collectorમાં જાય છે. Splitterથી streams ફરી ભળી જતા અટકે છે.

Shell retained magnetic particlesને field sectorની આસપાસ લઈ જાય છે. પૂરતી attractionની બહાર પહોંચતાં તે magnetic collectorમાં છૂટે છે. Field strength, liberation, layer depth/speed recovery તથા purityને અસર કરે છે. વધારે magnetic-product mass એટલે સારી separation નહીં; desired-component recovery અને grade અલગ ગણવા.

ઉપયોગો

  • Magnetic mineral/tramp iron recovery/removal.

મર્યાદા તથા સલામતી

  • Liberation, size, moisture/field strength અસર કરે. Strong magnets implants માટે જોખમી; guards બંધ રહે.

body.en:
Definition

A separator that concentrates suitably hydrophobic particles by attachment to rising bubbles.

Principle

  • Selective surface wettability, not density alone, determines bubble attachment and froth recovery.

Construction—detailed theory

A flotation cell contains a pulp tank with controlled slurry feed (1). An impeller and stator (2) suspend particles and disperse admitted air (3). The upper region allows a froth layer to form above the liquid pulp (4). A launder or skimming arrangement removes froth concentrate (5), and a lower outlet removes tailings (6).

The cell must provide contact between particles and bubbles without destroying all of the froth. Conditioning and reagents, where needed, are chosen for the particular mineral system and authorised procedure. The conceptual sketch does not specify a universal collector, frother or dose; surface properties, not density difference alone, provide the basis of flotation.

Working—detailed theory

Conditioned pulp enters the cell, where mixing keeps particles available for contact and breaks the admitted air into bubbles. Suitable hydrophobic particles attach to bubbles; particles that remain wetted do not readily attach. Attached particle-bubble aggregates rise because of the buoyancy of the gas-containing aggregate, not because the mineral itself has become less dense than water.

Rising aggregates enter the froth, where some liquid and entrained particles drain back to the pulp. Concentrate overflows or is skimmed into the launder, while the remaining slurry leaves as tailings. Air rate, agitation, conditioning and froth stability influence selectivity. Product grade and desired-component recovery are evaluated separately; excessive entrainment can increase mass yield while lowering purity.

Applications

  • Selective mineral recovery when surfaces can be suitably conditioned.

Limitations and safety

  • Collectors, frothers, depressants/pH are roles, not dosing recipes. Entrainment reduces selectivity. Only approved supervised materials in labs.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

યોગ્ય hydrophobic particlesને rising bubbles સાથે જોડીને concentrate કરતું સાધન.

સિદ્ધાંત

  • Selective surface wettabilityથી bubble attachment/froth recovery; માત્ર densityથી નહીં.

રચના—વિગતવાર સમજણ

Flotation cellમાં controlled slurry feedવાળો pulp tank (1) હોય છે. Impeller/stator (2) particles suspend કરે અને air admission (3)ને disperse કરે. Liquid pulp ઉપર froth zone (4) હોય છે. Launder/skimmerથી froth concentrate (5) અને lower outletથી tailings (6) મળે છે.

Cellમાં particle-bubble contact તથા ટકી શકે એવી froth layer બંને જરૂરી છે. જરૂરી conditioning/reagents mineral system તથા authorised procedure મુજબ હોય છે. Sketch universal collector/frother/dose આપતું નથી. Flotationનો આધાર surface properties છે, માત્ર density difference નહીં.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ—વિગતવાર સમજણ

Conditioned pulp cellમાં આવે; mixingથી particles contact માટે ઉપલબ્ધ રહે અને air bubblesમાં ફેલાય. Suitable hydrophobic particles bubbles સાથે જોડાય; wetted particles સહેલાઈથી જોડાતા નથી. Gasવાળા aggregateની buoyancyથી attached particles ઉપર ચડે છે; mineralની પોતાની density waterથી ઓછી થઈ જાય એવું નથી.

Rising aggregates frothમાં આવે; થોડું liquid/entrained particles પાછાં pulpમાં drain થાય. Concentrate overflow/skimmingથી launderમાં અને બાકી slurry tailingsમાં જાય. Air rate, agitation, conditioning/froth stability selectivityને અસર કરે. Grade/recovery અલગ માપવા; વધુ entrainmentથી mass yield વધે પણ purity ઘટી શકે છે.

ઉપયોગો

  • યોગ્ય surface conditioningથી selective mineral recovery.

મર્યાદા તથા સલામતી

  • Collector, frother, depressant/pHની ભૂમિકા સમજવી, dosing recipe નહીં. Entrainment selectivity ઘટાડે. Labમાં approved materials જ.

body.en:
Definition

Selection matches the separable property and product requirement to a suitable mechanism.

Factors and selection

  • Size contrast→screens; settling/density contrast→hydraulic separation; magnetic response→magnetic separation; wettability→flotation.
  • Check size distribution, liberation, shape, moisture, density, chemical compatibility, throughput and required grade/recovery.
  • Include water/energy, wear, dust, waste treatment, maintenance and safety; high recovery alone may give poor purity.

વ્યાખ્યા

પદાર્થના અલગ પાડી શકાય તેવા ગુણધર્મ તથા productની જરૂરને યોગ્ય mechanism સાથે મેળવો.

પરિબળો તથા પસંદગી

  • Size contrast→screen; settling/density→hydraulic; magnetic response→magnetic; wettability→flotation.
  • Size distribution, liberation, shape, moisture, density, compatibility, throughput તથા grade/recovery તપાસો.
  • Water/energy, wear, dust, waste, maintenance/safety પણ જુઓ; માત્ર high recoveryથી purity સારી જ ન હોય.

To find

Construct differential/cumulative percentages and obtain D80 by stated interpolation.

xi=mi/Σmi; retained cumulative=successive sum; passing=100−retained%.For log-size interpolation, use lnD versus percent passing between bracketing data.

Illustrative solved numerical—not laboratory readings

Given data

F=1000kg/h; coarse fractions xF=0.40, xO=0.90, xU=0.10; screen area A=2m².

To find

Find O, U, coarse/fine recoveries, overall effectiveness and area capacity.

Governing relation and assumptions

Steady dry balance with x=coarse fraction:O=F(xF−xU)/(xO−xU); U=F−O; E=[OxO/(FxF)]×[U(1−xU)/(F(1−xF))].

Calculation with substitution

  1. O=F(xF−xU)/(xO−xU)=375kg/h; U=625kg/h.
  2. Coarse recovery rC=OxO/(FxF)=337.5/400=0.84375.
  3. Fine recovery rF=U(1−xU)/[F(1−xF)]=562.5/600=0.9375.
  4. Overall E=rC rF=0.7910156=79.10%; area capacity F/A=500kg/(h·m²).
  5. Check coarse balance:337.5+62.5=400kg/h. Capacity alone is not separation quality.

Final answer

O=375kg/h; U=625kg/h; rC=0.84375; rF=0.9375; E=79.10%; F/A=500kg/(h·m²).

Unit/physical check

Total balance:375+625=1000.Coarse balance:337.5+62.5=400.Multiply recoveries as fractions, then multiply by100 once.

Illustrative solved numerical—not laboratory readings

Given data

Feed F=1.00kg with desired component fraction xF=0.40; concentrate C=0.35kg with xC=0.90.

To find

Find mass yield, concentrate grade, component recovery and tailings grade.

Governing relation and assumptions

Dry steady balance:T=F−C; yield=C/F; recovery=CxC/(FxF); tailings fraction xT=(FxF−CxC)/T.Multiply fractions by100 for percent.

Calculation with substitution

  1. Mass yield C/F=35%; concentrate grade=90%; desired-component recovery=CxC/(FxF)=78.75%.
  2. Tailings T=0.65kg; desired component remaining=0.400−0.315=0.085kg; tailings grade=13.08%.
  3. Report the efficiency definition:mass yield is not component recovery or concentrate purity.

Final answer

Yield=35%; concentrate grade=90%; component recovery=78.75%; T=0.65kg; tailings grade≈13.08%.

Unit/physical check

Concentrate component0.315kg+tailings component0.085kg=feed component0.400kg.Yield, purity and recovery are different measures.

સમજ માટે ઉકેલેલો દાખલો—પ્રયોગની readings નહીં

આપેલી માહિતી

Feed F=1.00kg, xF=0.40; concentrate C=0.35kg, xC=0.90.

શું શોધવું

Mass yield, concentrate grade, component recovery તથા tailings grade શોધો.

સૂત્ર તથા ધારણાઓ

Dry balance:T=F−C; yield=C/F; recovery=CxC/(FxF); xT=(FxF−CxC)/T.Percent માટે100થી ગુણો.

મૂલ્યો મૂકીને ગણતરી

  1. Mass yield35%; concentrate grade90%; desired-component recovery78.75%.

  3. Efficiencyની વ્યાખ્યા આપો:mass yield, component recovery તથા purity જુદાં.

અંતિમ જવાબ

Yield=35%; concentrate grade=90%; component recovery=78.75%; T=0.65kg; tailings grade≈13.08%.

એકમ તથા યોગ્યતાની ચકાસણી

Concentrate component0.315kg+tailings0.085kg=feed0.400kg.Yield, purity/recovery જુદાં measures છે.

body.en:
Aim and scope

  • Construct mass-fraction and cumulative passing/retained tables and curves.

Instruments/materials

  • Balance, covered sieves/shaker, pan, sample, semi-log plotting sheet or offline spreadsheet.

Connections/setup

  • Use the same controlled sieve arrangement as Practical1; record actual sieve openings.

Procedure

  1. Weigh feed and retained fractions after approved covered shaking.
  2. Arrange fractions in decreasing aperture order and reconcile recovered mass.
  3. Compute differential retained, cumulative retained and passing; plot versus actual opening.
  4. If required interpolate D80 on the stated linear/log-size basis only between bracketing measurements.

Blank observation sheet

  • Blank columns:opening ___mm, retained ___g, fraction ___, cumulative retained ___%, passing ___%; feed ___g, recovery error ___%.

Calculations and blank result

  • xi=mi/Σmi; Rc, i=Σj≤i xj; Pi=1−Rc, i. Result:table/curve ___, D80 ___mm on ___ basis.
  • Passing must rise with opening; do not interpolate through the pan using zero size on a log axis.

Safe fault-finding

  • Check reversed sieve order, percent/fraction confusion and losses; inspect mesh only after isolation.

Precautions

  • Use only the instructor-approved guarded trainer and compatible nonhazardous sample; record apparatus ID and authorised settings.
  • Isolate electrical/mechanical/pressure energy before opening, adjusting or clearing equipment; an emergency stop is not isolation.
  • Wear specified PPE, control dust/spills and follow the laboratory waste procedure; do not improvise live fault tests.

q.en: Define/explain: Ideal/actual screens and screen analysis
q.gu: વ્યાખ્યા/સમજણ: Ideal/Actual Screen તથા Screen Analysis

a.en: Screening partitions particles by ability to pass an aperture; actual separation is probabilistic and affected by shape, orientation and contact.
a.gu: Apertureમાંથી પસાર થવાની ક્ષમતા પરથી screening થાય; actual separation shape, orientation/contactને કારણે સંપૂર્ણ ચોક્કસ નથી.

q.gu: વ્યાખ્યા/સમજણ: Screen Capacity તથા Overall Effectiveness

a.en: Capacity is feed mass handled per time, or per screen area when stated. Effectiveness quantifies correct placement of both coarse and fine material.
